derivation: a prolonged form of G3415 (μιμνήσκω) (from which some of the tenses are borrowed);
strongs_def: to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind
it_def:
1) ricordare
   1a) essere ricordato, ricordare a sé stesso, ricordarsi
   1b) venire in mente, essere ricordato, essere un ricordo
   1c) ricordare una cosa
   1d) badare
